questions.stem: A company wants its on-premises applications to use cloud-backed storage while keeping local access patterns familiar. Which choices fit this need? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Use Amazon EFS as a standalone replacement for all local storage appliances
Provide local access while storing data in AWS
Use Amazon EBS volumes directly as local disks in the company data center
Use S3 storage classes to create a local file server in the data center
Use AWS Storage Gateway to connect local applications with AWS storage

questions.explanation:
AWS Storage Gateway supports hybrid cloud storage use cases by connecting on-premises applications with AWS storage. It can help organizations keep familiar local access patterns while using cloud-backed storage.

Providing local access while storing data in AWS reflects the role of AWS Storage Gateway. It supports environments that need to bridge local applications and AWS storage.

Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes are designed for use with Amazon EC2 instances. They are not attached directly as local disks in a company data center.

Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) provides managed file storage for use with AWS compute resources. It is not a standalone replacement for all local storage appliances in an on-premises environment.

S3 storage classes define object storage options in Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3). They do not create a local file server in a company data center.

optionExplanations.A:
Source explanation: AWS Storage Gateway supports hybrid cloud storage use cases by connecting on-premises applications with AWS storage. It can help organizations keep familiar local access patterns while using cloud-backed storage.

Which approach best aligns with AWS design principles to meet this requirement?

Route all traffic through a centralized endpoint
Increase compute capacity in the primary region
Deliver content from locations closer to end users

questions.explanation:

Increasing compute capacity does not reduce geographic latency.

Centralizing traffic can increase latency for distant users.

Limiting user access reduces load but does not improve performance for distributed users.

questions.stem: A finance leader is comparing traditional infrastructure spending with cloud-based spending. Which statements describe economic changes that can occur when using the AWS Cloud? (Select THREE.)

options.text: Commit to a fixed data center footprint before demand is known
Acquire capacity when it is needed rather than before demand is known
Use long procurement timelines as the standard way to obtain new resources
Shift large upfront purchases into operating expenses tied to consumption
Plan hardware refresh cycles as the primary way to add capacity
Make technology spending more closely follow actual use

Acquiring capacity when it is needed helps reduce the financial risk of overestimating future requirements. This supports a more flexible economic model than purchasing infrastructure far in advance.

Making technology spending follow actual use is a core cloud economics concept. Organizations can align consumption more closely with workload demand.

Committing to a fixed data center footprint before demand is known reflects a traditional infrastructure model. Cloud economics focuses on reducing that type of upfront capacity commitment.

Hardware refresh cycles are part of traditional infrastructure planning. AWS gives organizations access to infrastructure without making hardware replacement the main way to add capacity.

Long procurement timelines can slow delivery and increase planning overhead. Cloud-based access to resources helps reduce dependence on traditional purchasing cycles.

Which service selections match these needs? (Select THREE.)

Amazon Kendra
Amazon Redshift

Amazon Kinesis

Amazon EMR runs big data frameworks for processing and analyzing large datasets. It is not the managed intelligent enterprise search service.

Amazon Kinesis is used for real-time data streaming and processing. It does not create a relational data warehouse for analytics.

A sales organization wants to improve forecasting and identify purchasing trends across large amounts of customer data. Leadership is evaluating Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) services to help teams make more data-driven business decisions.

Which statement best describes how AI/ML services commonly support this type of business goal?

options.text: AI/ML services can analyze large datasets to identify patterns, generate predictions, and help organizations automate decision-making processes
AI/ML services focus on manually reviewing documents and records rather than identifying trends across large datasets
AI/ML services primarily replace all analytics and reporting workflows by eliminating the need for dashboards and business metrics
AI/ML services are mainly designed to convert streaming data directly into relational database schemas for long-term storage

questions.explanation:
Correct answer: AI/ML services can analyze large datasets to identify patterns, generate predictions, and help organizations automate decision-making processes

Organizations commonly use AI/ML services to identify trends, forecast outcomes, personalize recommendations, detect anomalies, and automate parts of business analysis. Services such as Amazon SageMaker AI can support workflows that process large amounts of data and generate insights that help organizations make more informed operational and strategic decisions.

AI/ML services do not eliminate the need for analytics dashboards and reporting tools because organizations still rely on reporting and visualization workflows alongside machine learning capabilities.

Streaming-data ingestion and database-schema design are different operational concerns than the business-analysis and prediction capabilities commonly associated with AI/ML services.

AI/ML services are frequently used to automate or assist with large-scale analysis tasks rather than relying entirely on manual document review processes.

questions.stem:
A workload processes files only when new uploads occur and remains idle most of the time. The development team wants to minimize infrastructure management and avoid paying for continuously running compute resources.

Which AWS service would best meet these requirements?

options.text: Amazon EKS
Amazon EC2
Amazon ECS
AWS Lambda

questions.explanation:
Correct answer: AWS Lambda

AWS Lambda is designed for event-driven execution and runs code only when triggered, making it well suited for workloads that remain idle between events. Lambda removes the need to manage servers and reduces costs associated with continuously running infrastructure.

Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) requires provisioning and managing continuously running virtual machines, even during idle periods.

Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) simplifies container orchestration but still involves container-based application management and is better suited for continuously running workloads.

Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) supports Kubernetes-based container orchestration and introduces additional operational complexity that is unnecessary for this scenario.

questions.stem: Internet connectivity for resources in a subnet stopped working even though the instances still had public IP addresses assigned. Which configuration issue is the most likely cause of this behavior?

options.text: The security groups now allow only outbound traffic
The route table no longer contains a route to an internet gateway
The Network Access Control List (NACL) contains stateless filtering rules
The subnet uses private IP addresses for internal communication

questions.explanation:
Correct answer: The route table no longer contains a route to an internet gateway.

Public internet connectivity in an Amazon Virtual Private Cloud ( Amazon VPC) requires both public IP addressing and a route table entry that directs traffic to an internet gateway. If the route to the internet gateway is removed, resources may still have public IP addresses but will no longer have a valid path for internet-bound traffic.

The security groups now allowing only outbound traffic would affect traffic-filtering behavior but would not by itself remove internet routing capability from the subnet.

The subnet using private IP addresses for internal communication is standard internal VPC behavior and does not explain the loss of internet routing.

The Network Access Control List ( NACL) containing stateless filtering rules is how NACLs function but does not specifically indicate that internet routing paths were removed.

Enabling Amazon CloudWatch logging improves operational visibility, but continuing to use shared administrator accounts weakens accountability and governance controls.

Assigning broader AWS managed policies would increase permission scope rather than reducing unnecessary access exposure.

A company provisions resources for its application based on estimated future demand. As usage patterns change, the application frequently has either excess capacity or insufficient resources. The company wants to improve efficiency and better match resources to actual usage.

Which approach best aligns with AWS design principles to meet this requirement?

options.text: Maintain additional capacity to ensure consistent performance
Allocate resources based on peak usage requirements
Adjust resource capacity dynamically based on usage patterns
Estimate future demand more frequently to improve planning accuracy

questions.explanation:

Estimating demand more frequently improves planning but does not eliminate mismatches between provisioned and actual usage.

A governance team wants to simplify how permissions are assigned to employees who perform similar job functions in AWS. The team also wants administrators to avoid updating permissions individually for each user whenever responsibilities change.

Which approach would best support these requirements?

options.text: Store IAM permission assignments in AWS Secrets Manager for centralized management
Assign users with similar responsibilities to IAM groups that share common permissions
Require all employees with similar responsibilities to share one IAM user account
Create separate copies of the same IAM policy for every individual user account

questions.explanation:
Correct answer: Assign users with similar responsibilities to IAM groups that share common permissions

IAM groups allow administrators to manage permissions collectively for users who perform similar operational roles. Updating permissions at the group level simplifies ongoing administration and reduces the need to manage permissions separately for each IAM user. This approach also preserves accountability because users maintain individual identities within the AWS environment.

Creating duplicate IAM policies for each user increases administrative complexity and makes long-term permission management more difficult.

AWS Secrets Manager securely stores secrets, such as passwords and API keys, but it is not used to organize or assign IAM permissions.

Sharing a single IAM user account weakens accountability and reduces visibility into which employee performed specific AWS actions.

questions.stem: A storage team is reviewing object storage options for data with changing access patterns. Which choices align with S3 storage class and lifecycle use cases? (Select THREE.)

options.text: Use S3 Glacier storage classes for data that must be modified constantly
Use S3 Standard for data that is accessed frequently
Use lifecycle policies as a replacement for choosing a storage class
Use S3 Standard-Infrequent Access as the primary choice for frequently accessed active data
Use lifecycle policies to move objects as access patterns change
Use an infrequent-access storage class for data that still needs rapid retrieval

questions.explanation:
S3 Standard is designed for frequently accessed object data. It is a suitable default when data needs regular access and low-latency retrieval.

An infrequent-access storage class can be appropriate for data that is accessed less often but still requires rapid access when needed. The storage class should match the expected access pattern.

Lifecycle policies can transition objects between storage classes or expire objects based on defined rules. They help manage object storage over time as data access changes.

Lifecycle policies are not a replacement for storage classes. A lifecycle policy applies rules to objects, while storage classes define how objects are stored.

S3 Glacier storage classes are suited for archive-oriented or rarely accessed data, not data that must be modified constantly. Frequently changed data generally needs a different storage approach.

S3 Standard-Infrequent Access is not the primary fit for frequently accessed active data. It is intended for less frequently accessed data that still needs rapid retrieval.

questions.stem: A company is reviewing ways to lower AWS costs while still matching workload requirements to appropriate pricing options. Which actions align with AWS pricing best practices? (Select THREE.)

options.text: Use lower-cost Amazon S3 storage classes for data that is accessed less frequently
Use Spot Instances for fault-tolerant workloads that can handle interruption
Use Savings Plans for predictable compute usage across eligible services
Use Dedicated Hosts solely to obtain the lowest general-purpose compute price
Use On-Demand Instances for every steady production workload to maximize discounts
Use Capacity Reservations alone as the primary way to reduce EC2 pricing

questions.explanation:
Spot Instances can lower compute costs for workloads that can pause, retry, or recover from interruption. This makes them a good fit for fault-tolerant processing where availability of spare capacity is acceptable.

Savings Plans can reduce costs when an organization can commit to a consistent amount of eligible compute usage. They are appropriate when usage is predictable enough to support a commitment.

Lower-cost S3 storage classes can reduce storage costs when data access patterns support the change. Matching storage class to access frequency is a core pricing consideration for AWS storage.

On-Demand Instances provide flexibility, but they are not the discount-maximizing option for every steady production workload. Predictable workloads may be better candidates for commitment-based pricing options.

Capacity Reservations help ensure EC2 capacity is available when needed. They do not, by themselves, function as the primary discount mechanism for EC2 pricing.

Dedicated Hosts are used for requirements such as licensing, compliance, or physical server isolation. They are not generally selected solely to obtain the lowest compute price.

questions.stem:
A company grants broad permissions to users, so they can quickly access cloud resources. Over time, this approach increases the risk of unauthorized actions. The company wants to improve security while maintaining appropriate access.

Which approach best aligns with AWS design principles to meet this requirement?

options.text: Assign identical permissions to all users for consistency
Allow all users full access to simplify resource management
Grant only the permissions required to perform specific tasks
Remove access controls to eliminate permission errors

questions.explanation:
Correct answer: Grant only the permissions required to perform specific tasks

Granting only the permissions required supports the principle of least privilege, which reduces the risk of unauthorized access or accidental changes. This improves security by limiting actions to what is necessary for each role while maintaining appropriate access to resources.

Allowing full access increases the risk of misuse and does not follow security best practices.

Assigning identical permissions ignores differences in user responsibilities and can lead to excessive access.

Removing access controls eliminates security protections and increases risk.

questions.stem:
A company plans to migrate a legacy application to AWS. The application must remain available during the transition, and the team wants to improve system performance and update supporting components without changing the application’s core architecture.

Which migration strategy best fits this requirement?

options.text: Refactor the application into cloud-native services
Replatform the application during migration
Rehost the application without modification
Repurchase the application as a SaaS solution

questions.explanation:
Correct answer: Replatform the application during migration

Replatforming involves moving an application to the cloud while making limited changes to the underlying platform, such as updating the operating system or improving database performance. This approach preserves the core architecture while allowing targeted optimizations that improve performance and efficiency. It is often used when a full redesign is unnecessary, but some modernization is beneficial.

Rehosting moves the application without changes, so it would not include updates to supporting components or performance improvements.

Refactoring requires redesigning the application into cloud-native services, which introduces significant architectural changes beyond the stated requirement.

Repurchasing replaces the existing application with a SaaS product, which does not maintain the original application during migration.

A retail analytics team wants to prepare raw transactional datasets before running queries and building reports. The team needs a managed service that can help discover, transform, and organize incoming data for analytics workflows.

Which combination of AWS services aligns with these requirements?

options.text: AWS Glue and Amazon Athena
Amazon Kinesis and Amazon Polly
Amazon Rekognition and Amazon QuickSight
AWS Glue and Amazon Kendra

questions.explanation:

questions.stem:
A retail analytics platform uses Amazon EC2 for application servers, Amazon S3 for report storage, and Amazon CloudWatch for monitoring. During a post-deployment review, the operations team evaluates which activities AWS manages directly within the environment.

Which task is managed by AWS under the shared responsibility model?

options.text: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) role assignment for application administrators
Amazon CloudWatch alarm threshold definition
Amazon S3 bucket access policy configuration
Amazon EC2 host operating system patching

questions.explanation:
Correct answer: Amazon EC2 host operating system patching

AWS manages the underlying physical hosts and virtualization infrastructure that support Amazon EC2 instances. This includes maintaining and patching the host operating systems used by the AWS cloud platform itself, while customers remain responsible for the guest operating systems running inside their own instances.

Configuring Amazon S3 bucket access policies remains part of controlling access to customer-managed data and resources.

Defining Amazon CloudWatch alarm thresholds still requires customers to determine which operational metrics and alert conditions are appropriate for their workloads.

Assigning AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) roles to administrators continues to fall under customer responsibility for identity governance and access control.

questions.stem:
An enterprise plans to separate development, testing, and production workloads into multiple AWS accounts while maintaining centralized governance controls across the environment.

Which AWS capability best supports this requirement?

options.text: Using Organizational Units (OUs) to automatically encrypt resources across multiple AWS accounts
Using AWS Artifact reports to apply governance controls across accounts
Using AWS Organizations with Organizational Units (OUs) and Service Control Policies (SCPs)
Using Service Control Policies (SCPs) and AWS Config rules to monitor resource configuration changes across accounts

questions.explanation:
Correct answer: Using AWS Organizations with Organizational Units (OUs) and Service Control Policies (SCPs)

AWS Organizations helps enterprises centrally manage and govern multiple AWS accounts within a single environment. Organizational Units (OUs) group accounts logically, while Service Control Policies (SCPs) define permission guardrails across those accounts.

SCPs and AWS Config both support governance activities, but they do not together provide the centralized multi-account organizational structure required for account grouping and governance management.

OUs help organize accounts within AWS Organizations, but they do not automatically apply encryption to resources.

AWS Artifact provides access to AWS compliance reports and agreements, but it does not apply centralized governance controls across AWS accounts.

questions.stem: A team wants to create repeatable environments and reduce manual configuration differences. Which practices support this goal? (Select THREE.)

options.text: Recreate resources from memory in the console
Use AWS CloudFormation to provision consistent stacks
Store environment definitions in version control
Record the desired configuration in a spreadsheet as the deployment source
Define infrastructure in templates
Use support cases as the provisioning workflow

questions.explanation:
Defining infrastructure in templates supports infrastructure as code. This helps teams create environments consistently instead of relying on manual configuration steps.

Storing environment definitions in version control helps teams track changes and reuse known configurations. It also supports review and rollback of infrastructure definitions.

AWS CloudFormation can provision AWS resources from templates. It supports consistent stack creation and helps reduce differences between environments.

Recreating resources from memory in the console can introduce variation and human error. That approach works against the goal of consistent environment creation.

Support cases are not a provisioning workflow for creating application environments. They are used for support interactions rather than defining and deploying infrastructure.

A spreadsheet can document desired settings, but it is not an infrastructure deployment source. Infrastructure as code uses executable definitions or templates to create resources consistently.

questions.stem:
A security team is reviewing several AWS networking configurations and wants to identify a design that minimizes direct inbound exposure from the public internet while still allowing private-subnet resources to download software updates and access external services.

Which configuration best supports this goal?

options.text: Place the resources in a private subnet, and route outbound traffic through a NAT gateway
Attach an internet gateway directly to the instances in the subnet
Place the resources in a public subnet, and restrict traffic with security groups
Assign Elastic IP addresses to resources located in a private subnet

questions.explanation:
Correct answer: Place the resources in a private subnet, and route outbound traffic through a NAT gateway

A private subnet helps prevent direct inbound internet access to resources while still allowing internal Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) communication. A NAT gateway enables outbound internet connectivity for resources in the private subnet, so systems can download updates or access external services without becoming directly reachable from the internet.

Placing the resources in a public subnet and restricting traffic with security groups still associates the resources with direct internet routing through the subnet configuration.

Assigning Elastic IP addresses to resources located in a private subnet introduces public internet addressing rather than preserving private-only exposure boundaries.

Attaching an internet gateway directly to the instances in the subnet is not how internet gateways function within an Amazon VPC architecture and would increase internet accessibility rather than minimize it.

questions.stem: A security administrator wants to reduce the likelihood that AWS users accidentally receive permissions beyond what their job responsibilities require. Which access-management practice would best support this goal?

options.text: Share IAM user accounts among employees who perform similar operational tasks
Grant only the permissions required for each user’s operational responsibilities
Assign all users the same AWS managed policies to simplify administration
Provide administrator-level access to users who occasionally troubleshoot applications

questions.explanation:
Correct answer: Grant only the permissions required for each user’s operational responsibilities

Granting only the permissions needed for assigned responsibilities supports the principle of least privilege. Limiting unnecessary access reduces security exposure and helps organizations maintain stronger governance over AWS resources and operations. This approach is a foundational AWS security and access-management practice.

Assigning the same AWS managed policies to all users can simplify administration, but it may also grant permissions unrelated to many users’ actual responsibilities.

Providing administrator-level access for occasional troubleshooting increases unnecessary access exposure and weakens permission governance.

Sharing IAM user accounts reduces accountability because actions performed in AWS environments cannot be tied clearly to individual users.

questions.stem:
A company plans to migrate large volumes of historical data to AWS. The data does not change frequently, but the initial transfer will take too long over the existing network connection. The company wants to complete the migration efficiently without upgrading network bandwidth.

Which approach best meets these requirements?

options.text: Increase throughput by running multiple parallel transfers over the same connection
Schedule the data transfer during off-peak hours to maximize available bandwidth
Throttle the data transfer to reduce impact on the existing network connection
Transfer the data using a physical device designed for offline data migration

questions.explanation:
Correct answer: Transfer the data using a physical device designed for offline data migration

Using a physical transfer device allows large datasets to be moved to AWS without relying on network bandwidth. This approach significantly reduces transfer time for bulk data and is commonly used when network limitations would make online transfer impractical. AWS provides services such as AWS Snowball that support secure, large-scale offline data transfer.

Throttling the transfer reduces network impact but extends the total migration time and does not address the bandwidth limitation.

Scheduling transfers during off-peak hours may improve utilization slightly, but the overall transfer speed remains constrained by the same network capacity.

Running parallel transfers increases competition for the same limited bandwidth and does not significantly improve total transfer time.

questions.stem: A seasonal business wants to understand how elasticity can affect infrastructure spending. Which claims describe the economic effect of elasticity? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Avoid maintaining peak-season infrastructure throughout slower periods
Plan capacity around the busiest season even when demand is lower
Add capacity during busy periods, and scale back when demand returns to normal
Treat elasticity as a replacement for application availability design
Stop reviewing consumption after scaling policies are in place

questions.explanation:
Elasticity allows capacity to expand and contract as demand changes. This can help organizations support busy periods without maintaining the same resource level at all times.

Avoiding peak-season infrastructure during slower periods can reduce idle capacity. This is an economic benefit when demand varies across seasons, events, or business cycles.

Planning capacity around the busiest season, even when demand is lower, works against the economic value of elasticity. The benefit comes from adjusting capacity rather than maintaining the largest footprint continuously.

Application availability is a separate design concern from elasticity. Elasticity can help respond to demand, but it does not replace resilient architecture.

Consumption still needs review in an elastic environment. Elasticity helps adjust capacity, but organizations still need to understand usage patterns and resource behavior.

questions.stem:
A company notices that its application performance occasionally degrades, but the cause is unclear. The team needs a way to understand system behavior over time and identify when issues occur.

Which capability would best help the team meet these requirements?

options.text: Review access logs to determine which users are interacting with the system
Collect and analyze performance data to observe trends and detect anomalies
Audit configuration changes to identify recent modifications to resources
Collect application logs to review individual events and error messages

questions.explanation:
Correct answer: Collect and analyze performance data to observe trends and detect anomalies

Collecting and analyzing performance data provides visibility into how the system behaves over time, making it possible to identify patterns and detect abnormal conditions. This helps teams diagnose the root cause of performance issues by correlating metrics such as latency, throughput, and resource utilization.

Collecting application logs provides detailed event-level information, but logs alone do not easily reveal systemwide performance trends over time.

Reviewing access logs shows user activity but does not provide insight into internal system performance.

Auditing configuration changes can help identify recent modifications, but it does not provide continuous visibility into runtime behavior.

questions.stem:
A financial services team wants contractors to access approved internal websites from unmanaged personal devices without allowing direct access to the corporate network or local data downloads.

Which approach aligns with this requirement?

options.text: Coordinate software build, test, and deployment stages through an automated CI/CD workflow
Distribute application messages through queue-based asynchronous processing workflows
Provide browser-isolated access to approved web applications without exposing the internal network directly to user devices
Provide persistent virtual desktop environments that retain user settings and installed applications between sessions

questions.explanation:
Correct answer: Provide browser-isolated access to approved web applications without exposing the internal network directly to user devices

Amazon WorkSpaces Secure Browser helps organizations provide secure browser-based access to internal websites and SaaS applications from managed or unmanaged devices. Browser isolation can reduce direct exposure of internal resources while helping organizations control access to approved web content.

Persistent virtual desktop workflows align more closely with Amazon WorkSpaces, which provides full desktop environments rather than isolated browser access.

CI/CD workflows such as AWS CodePipeline focus on software delivery automation rather than controlled browser-based access to internal web resources.

Queue-based messaging workflows such as Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) support asynchronous application communication rather than secure browser isolation.

Increase the size of the shared database instance
Centralize all data access through a single processing layer

questions.explanation:

Centralizing data access increases reliance on a single component and can worsen bottlenecks.

Limiting requests reduces load but does not address the underlying architectural dependency.

questions.stem:
Administrators need to remotely manage Amazon EC2 instances that are located in a private subnet. Direct inbound access from the internet to the private instances should be avoided.

Which approach supports this requirement?

options.text: Move the private instances into a public subnet
Use a bastion host in a public subnet
Assign public IP addresses to the private instances
Attach an internet gateway directly to the private instances

questions.explanation:
Correct answer: Use a bastion host in a public subnet

A bastion host, also called a jump server, is an administrative access server typically deployed in a public subnet and used to securely connect to resources in private subnets through private IP addresses inside an Amazon Virtual Private Cloud ( Amazon VPC). Modern AWS environments often use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager as an alternative administrative access method that reduces the need for bastion hosts.

Assigning public IP addresses to the private instances would expose those resources directly to the internet and remove the isolation benefits of the private subnet.

Moving the private instances into a public subnet would increase direct internet accessibility rather than preserve restricted access.

Attaching an internet gateway directly to the private instances is not how internet gateways function within an Amazon Virtual Private Cloud ( Amazon VPC) architecture.

A company stores large volumes of data in AWS. Some data is accessed frequently when first created, but access drops significantly over time. The company wants to optimize storage costs without manually managing data placement.

Which approach best meets these requirements?

options.text: Automatically transition data between storage tiers based on access patterns
Move all data to a lower-cost storage option after a fixed period
Keep all data in the same storage tier to simplify management
Regularly review and manually move data to different storage options

questions.explanation:
Correct answer: Automatically transition data between storage tiers based on access patterns

Using lifecycle policies, such as those in Amazon S3, allows data to be automatically moved between storage classes as access patterns change. Moving all data after a fixed period does not account for varying access patterns and may move data prematurely.

Keeping all data in the same tier simplifies management but does not optimize costs.

Manually reviewing and moving data increases operational effort and is less efficient than automated policies.

questions.stem: An architecture review team is comparing design priorities across the Well-Architected pillars. Which pillar descriptions are correctly matched to their design focus? (Select TWO.)

Performance efficiency focuses on protecting information from unauthorized access
Reliability focuses on recovering from disruption and meeting workload availability needs

In contrast, protecting information from unauthorized access aligns with the security pillar, not the performance efficiency pillar. Performance efficiency focuses on using computing resources efficiently to meet system requirements.

Selecting the fastest resources for every workload does not represent cost optimization. Cost optimization focuses on delivering business value while avoiding unnecessary expense.

Owning more physical infrastructure does not describe the sustainability pillar. Sustainability focuses on minimizing environmental impacts and using resources efficiently.

questions.stem:
A company is evaluating database options for a new financial application. The application requires a relational database platform with automatic backups, patching support, and reduced administrative effort.

Which database approach would be the most appropriate for this requirement?

options.text: Use a data warehouse platform
Use a NoSQL database platform
Use a self-managed database hosted on Amazon EC2
Use a managed relational database service

questions.explanation:
Correct answer: Use a managed relational database service

A managed relational database service reduces operational overhead by handling tasks such as automated backups, software patching, monitoring, and high availability configuration. Amazon RDS and Amazon Aurora are examples of AWS managed relational database services that support these capabilities.

Using a self-managed database hosted on Amazon EC2 requires the customer to manage backups, patching, scaling, and failover configuration manually.

Using a NoSQL database platform supports flexible nonrelational workloads rather than traditional relational database requirements for structured transactional applications.

Using a data warehouse platform for analytics queries is designed for large-scale reporting and analytics workloads rather than operational transactional database processing.

questions.stem:
A company must ensure its application remains available during a large-scale outage affecting an entire AWS Region. The company must also keep customer data within a specific country due to regulatory requirements.

Which approach would best meet these requirements?

options.text: Deploy the application across multiple AWS Regions while keeping data in the required country
Increase the number of instances within one Availability Zone
Use edge locations to deliver content closer to users
Deploy the application across multiple Availability Zones within a single Region

questions.explanation:
Correct answer: Deploy the application across multiple AWS Regions while keeping data in the required country

Using multiple Regions provides protection against Region-level outages, ensuring the application remains available during large-scale failures. It also allows the company to meet data residency requirements by storing regulated data in a specific geographic location.

Deploying across multiple Availability Zones improves availability within a Region but does not protect against a Regionwide outage.

Edge locations improve content delivery performance but do not provide application failover or data residency control.

Increasing instances within a single Availability Zone improves capacity but does not address availability or regulatory requirements.

questions.stem: A cloud practitioner is reviewing common statements about AWS storage services and data protection. Which statements are accurate? (Select THREE.)

options.text: AWS Backup can centrally manage backups for supported AWS services
S3 lifecycle policies create block storage volumes for compute instances
Amazon EBS provides managed file storage for shared access across many compute resources
AWS Backup is an S3 storage class for archival objects
S3 lifecycle policies can transition objects between storage classes
S3 Glacier storage classes support archive-oriented object storage use cases

questions.explanation:
AWS Backup can centrally manage backups across supported AWS services. It helps organizations apply backup management consistently without treating backup as a storage class.

S3 lifecycle policies can transition objects between storage classes based on rules. This supports object management as access patterns or retention needs change.

S3 Glacier storage classes support archive-oriented object storage use cases. They are appropriate for data that is retained for long periods and accessed less frequently.

AWS Backup is not an S3 storage class. It is a backup management service, while S3 storage classes define how objects are stored in Amazon S3.

S3 lifecycle policies do not create block storage volumes for compute instances. Block storage volumes align with Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS).

Amazon EBS provides block storage volumes, not managed shared file storage for many compute resources. Shared file storage aligns with services such as Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS).
